description:
Resilient Redis-backed InstanceEventStore for Spring Boot Admin. The in-memory log
        is authoritative (extends SBA's InMemoryEventStore); Redis is a fully reactive (Lettuce, no
        blocking calls) write-behind mirror for durability. A Redis outage never blanks the registry
        (reads stay in-memory) and never fails a write — it's surfaced as a non-fatal DEGRADED health
        status instead. Hydrates from Redis on startup. Connection uses the standard spring.data.redis.*
        config. Opt-in via sba.eventstore.type=redis.
